name: drag-item
title: Drag Item
description: The one visual recipe for a use-drag-reorder item — drop-edge hairlines on all four edges, the lift dim, and the pending shimmer — shared by Board and SortableList instead of copied into each.

meta.whenToUse: Building a drag surface on use-drag-reorder — spread it onto the element carrying the hook`s getItemProps() attributes.
meta.whenNotToUse: File drag-in (use-file-drop) or any surface that does not use the reorder hook.
